extensions.name: Apple Music charts
extensions.description: The most played songs on Apple Music in your country, and each genre's top songs on the iTunes Store, from Apple's public charts feeds.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Internet Archive comics
extensions.description: Comic strips, comic books and children's papers in the Internet Archive's comics collection that are in the public domain by age: published more than 95 years ago.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Audius
extensions.description: Trending and underground songs by genre from Audius, the open music platform where artists upload their own songs, playable in full. No account needed.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Deezer
extensions.description: Song, artist and album search, charts (the top songs, each genre's and the decades'), songs for any genre or mood, song genres, and similar artists, new releases and radios for Made for You, from Deezer's public API.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Project Gutenberg
extensions.description: Over 70,000 free public-domain books from Project Gutenberg, split into chapters to read like a novel.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Internet Archive
extensions.description: Public-domain and Creative Commons audio and films from the Internet Archive.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: KuGou lyrics
extensions.description: Synced lyrics from KuGou's lyric service, as Kreate and RiMusic use it: strong on Chinese, Japanese and Korean songs, with Chinese translations and romanized lines for many.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: LibriVox
extensions.description: Free public-domain audiobooks read by LibriVox volunteers: found by title, author or genre through the Internet Archive and LibriVox's own catalogue, and played chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: ListenBrainz
extensions.description: The songs most listened to on the open ListenBrainz service this week, month and year, fresh singles, and songs for any genre or mood from its tag radio.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Lit2Go
extensions.description: Free audiobooks of classic stories, novels and poems from the University of South Florida's Lit2Go, by title, author or genre, played chapter by chapter.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Loyal Books
extensions.description: Free public-domain audiobooks from Loyal Books (Books Should Be Free), by popularity and genre, played chapter by chapter from each book's feed.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: LRCLIB
extensions.description: Synced lyrics from the open LRCLIB database.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: MangaDex
extensions.description: Manga from MangaDex, the scanlation library run by its community. Covers and pages load through Raygun.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: MANGA Plus Creators
extensions.description: Manga that creators post themselves on Shueisha's MANGA Plus Creators, free to read, in English or Spanish.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: MusicBrainz
extensions.description: Song search, song genres, artist facts and song credits from the open MusicBrainz database, with artist summaries from Wikipedia. Results play through streaming extensions.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Naver Webtoon
extensions.description: Korean webtoons from Naver Webtoon, free to read: the weekly series, finished ones and genres, in Korean.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: PeerTube
extensions.description: Videos and live streams from PeerTube's federated instances, found through SepiaSearch. Its own pill in Search.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Pepper&Carrot
extensions.description: David Revoy's fantasy webcomic about a young witch and her cat, free under CC BY 4.0, in its readers' many translations.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Podcast directory
extensions.description: Search millions of podcasts and browse the top shows, through Apple's public iTunes Search API.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Radio Browser
extensions.description: Live internet radio from the community-run radio-browser.info station directory.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: Tapas
extensions.description: Comics from Tapas: its rankings, genres and search, with the episodes that are free to read without an account.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: WEBTOON
extensions.description: Free episodes from WEBTOON: the publisher's Originals and its Canvas of creators' own series, in seven languages, with rankings, genres and search.
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: xkcd
extensions.description: Every xkcd comic by Randall Munroe, from the first to today's, each a chapter of its own (CC BY-NC 2.5).
extensions.author: Raygun

extensions.name: YouTube
extensions.description: Music search, playlists (community and featured) and lyrics through YouTube Music, songs played and downloaded as YouTube's own audio files (its embedded player when those aren't given), and videos and live streams in Search's YouTube pill. No key needed; add your own YouTube Data API key to use the official API for music instead.
extensions.author: Raygun
